resources.string: Choose how much control to keep in this conversation.
You review tool actions before they run. Explicit grants for this chat still apply.
An independent Review Agent checks each action and its arguments. Risky or uncertain actions come back to you.
Skip normal tool prompts for files, app controls and network requests. Root and Android permission checks still apply.
Uses the current model in a separate session with no tools or execution rights. Review calls use tokens. Your blacklist, MCP and mandatory human confirmations stay in effect.
Your choice is saved on this device and becomes the default for new chats. Changing levels clears this chat’s previous tool grants. Root and Android system grants are managed separately.
